title: ISCode grammar
description: Definition of an ISCode language level (convert/<level>/v<version>.json). Each source line is matched against instruction regexes (first match wins); recognized lines become AST nodes which are rendered per target into output zones.

name.description: Level name; must match the folder name (convert/<name>/) and the source file extension or '#! iscode-level' header.

version.description: Grammar version; a source file selects it with '#! iscode-version: <n>'.

pipeline.description: AST-to-AST passes applied before rendering (TypeScript passes referenced by name, e.g. "resolveParams").

target.description: Level expected in the produced file when translating to a lower ISCode level.

availableTranslation.description: Output formats offered in the target menu.

extension.description: Extension of the produced file (without dot).

grammar.description: Render with another level's grammar (e.g. isc1 rendered with isc0).

target.description: Render key inside the output grammar's translations (defaults to the target name).

emitHeader.description: Prepend '#! iscode-level/version' to the generated file (makes ISCode outputs re-translatable).

tokens.description: Named regex fragments, reused in instruction syntaxes. Each syntax token becomes a capture group (%{1}, %{2}...).

instructions.description: Instructions in declaration order: the FIRST instruction whose regex matches a line wins.

syntax.description: Ordered token names composing the instruction regex.

ast.description: AST node template. Must define 'op'; values may use %{n} placeholders (regex captures).

snippet.description: Autocompletion snippet (VS Code / Monaco snippet syntax).

translation.description: Per render target: entries placed in output zones. Placeholders are named after AST fields (%{dst}, %{src}...).

zone.description: Output zone (from renderZoneOrder); original indentation is re-applied in 'body'.

line.description: One line, or several lines, emitted in the zone.
